clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Highperch, wyvern eggs leave shells hardened by Thousand Needles' desert heat. Armorer Mathiel in Darnassus uses them to make lacquer for mail links.

Highperch wyverns lay eggs on the mesa needles of southern Kalimdor. Beneath their roosts, discarded shell fragments bake in the desert sun and searing winds. Their brittle remains hold a natural resilience that draws the attention of skilled artisans.

In Darnassus, armorer Mathiel studies methods pioneered by his colleague, the dwarf smith Furen Longbeard. Mathiel processes the shells into a fine lacquer for mail armor. Applied to the metal links, the coating strengthens them without burdening the wearer.
